CMPackingType.doc: The type of packing within each video frame, if any.

kCMPackingType_None.doc: Each frame contains only a single image, and isn’t frame-packed.

kCMPackingType_OverUnder.doc: The video contains packed frames that have a left eye image on the top and right eye image on the bottom.

kCMPackingType_SideBySide.doc: The video contains packed frames that have a left eye image on the left and right eye image on the right.

CMProjectionType.doc: Constants describing the projection surface information in a 3D video buffer or channel.

kCMProjectionType_Equirectangular.doc: Video content displays as a 360 degree equirectangular projection.

kCMProjectionType_Fisheye.doc: Video content displays as a fisheye projection.

kCMProjectionType_HalfEquirectangular.doc: Video content displays as a 180 degree equirectangular projection.

kCMProjectionType_Rectangular.doc: Video content displays on a flat, rectangular 2D surface.

CMStereoViewComponents.doc: Constants describing the stereo views contained within a buffer or channel.

kCMStereoView_LeftEye.doc: The stereo video track includes a left eye layer.

kCMStereoView_None.doc: A constant for video metadata to have no available stereo frames.

kCMStereoView_RightEye.doc: The stereo video track includes a right eye layer.

CMStereoViewInterpretationOptions.doc: Create a set of stereo view interpretation options from a constant.

init(rawValue:).doc: Create a new option set with a given value.

kCMStereoViewInterpretation_AdditionalVi.doc: A flag indicating that the video content contains additional views beyond the left or right eye.

kCMStereoViewInterpretation_Default.doc: The default options for stereo video views.

kCMStereoViewInterpretation_StereoOrderR.doc: Changes the default ordering of eye data, switching it from left-to-right to right-to-left.

CMTagCategory.doc: A 64-bit representation of a tag’s category.

kCMTagCategory_ChannelID.doc: A category used for tagging a channel ID.

kCMTagCategory_MediaSubType.doc: A category used for tagging media subtype metadata.

kCMTagCategory_MediaType.doc: A category used for tagging media type metadata.

kCMTagCategory_PackingType.doc: A category used for tagging frame-packing information.

kCMTagCategory_PixelFormat.doc: A category used for tagging pixel format information.

kCMTagCategory_ProjectionType.doc: A category used for tagging projection surface information.

kCMTagCategory_StereoView.doc: A category used for tagging eye information for 3D video.

kCMTagCategory_StereoViewInterpretation.doc: A category used for tagging how to interpret stereo view metadata.

kCMTagCategory_TrackID.doc: A category used for tagging a track ID.

kCMTagCategory_Undefined.doc: An unknown or undefined tag category.

kCMTagCategory_VideoLayerID.doc: A category used for tagging a video layer ID.

CMTagCollectionError.doc: Error codes returned by Core Media when working with tag collections.

kCMTagCollectionError_ExhaustedBufferSiz.doc: Indicates that a buffer was smaller than the number of requested tags.

kCMTagCollectionError_InternalError.doc: Indicates an error occurred inside of the Core Media framework.

kCMTagCollectionError_InvalidTag.doc: Indicates that the collection contains an invalid tag.

kCMTagCollectionError_InvalidTagCollecti.doc: Indicates that a Core Foundation data instance failed to initialize a new tag collection.
Indicates that a Core Foundation data instance failed to initialize a new tag collection due to a versioning problem.
Indicates that a Core Foundation dictionary instance failed to initialize a new tag collection.

kCMTagCollectionError_NotYetImplemented.doc: Indicates a function lacks a necessary backing implementation in Core Media.

kCMTagCollectionError_ParamErr.doc: Indicates a parameter to a function was of the wrong type or didn’t meet a necessary condition.

kCMTagCollectionError_TagNotFound.doc: Indicates that there was no match in a collection for a tag.

CMTagDataType.doc: The data type of a tag’s value.

kCMTagDataType_Flags.doc: The tag value is a 64-bit wide bitflag field.

kCMTagDataType_Float64.doc: The tag value is a 64-bit floating point number.

kCMTagDataType_Invalid.doc: The tag value isn’t associated with any known data type.

kCMTagDataType_OSType.doc: The tag value is a 64-bit identifier used by the operating system.

kCMTagDataType_SInt64.doc: The tag value is a signed 64-bit integer.

CMTagError.doc: Core media tagging errors reported by the framework.

kCMTagError_AllocationFailed.doc: An error where the system can’t allocate enough memory for the tag.

kCMTagError_ParamErr.doc: An error where input or output parameters didn’t match the requirements of Core Media.

CMTaggedBufferGroupError.doc: Error codes returned by Core Media when working with tagged buffer groups.

kCMTaggedBufferGroupError_InternalError.doc: Indicates an error occurred inside of the Core Media framework.

kCMTaggedBufferGroupError_ParamErr.doc: Indicates a parameter to a function was of the wrong type or didn’t meet a necessary condition.

CMTimeFlags.doc: A structure that defines the flags for a time value.

kCMTimeFlags_HasBeenRounded.doc: A flag that indicates a previous time calculation rounded the result.

kCMTimeFlags_ImpliedValueFlagsMask.doc: A flag that indicates the time is positive or negative infinity, or indefinite.

kCMTimeFlags_Indefinite.doc: A flag that indicates the time is indefinite.

kCMTimeFlags_NegativeInfinity.doc: A flag that indicates the time is negative infinity.

kCMTimeFlags_PositiveInfinity.doc: A flag that indicates the time is positive infinity.

kCMTimeFlags_Valid.doc: A flag that indicates a time is valid.

CMTimeRoundingMethod.doc: An enumeration of rounding methods to use when performing time calculations.

CMBlockBufferCustomBlockSource.doc: A structure to support custom memory allocation and deallocation for a block used in a block buffer.

CMBufferCallbacks.doc: A structure that stores the callbacks that perform buffer operations.

CMBufferHandlers.doc: A structure that stores the handlers that perform buffer operations.

CMSampleTimingInfo.doc: A collection of timing information for a sample in a sample buffer.

CMTag.doc: A tag to set additional metadata on media buffers.

CMTimeMapping.doc: A structure that maps a segment of a source time range to a target time range.

CMTimeRange.doc: A structure that represents a time range.

CMVideoDimensions.doc: A structure that represents video dimensions.
